items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I played with a band in Scranton and I played with Alfie Evans and his father.

ctx.x: Played with other bands, the local bands.

Anyway, I played with a band in Scranton and I played with Alfie Evans and his father. His father was a trumpet player, and Alfie was a fiddle player. He came down and he -- you know, a fiddle was quite a thing in an orchestra in those days and Alfie could play very well. Played very well, and then the next time I run into Alfie he's playing saxophone with the Sirens, he and Jimmy.
We used to play some dances up at Penn State.
